cash_realization_gap: Category customer receipts and source-of-funds allocation are missing.
target_document_family: SPPCRC 2027 actual/estimated true-up and category allocation workpapers
source_route: Florida PSC Docket 20250010-EI; FPL 2026 actual/estimated SPPCRC filing expected in 2027; Form 2A/5P/6P/7A/8A workpapers
fields_to_extract: program; month; billed revenue; collected revenue; customer class; billing determinant; factor; category allocation; true-up balance; funding source
upgrade_rule: Upgrade if Distribution Inspection customer cash or billing allocation is visible for the same period and source-of-funds allocation is disclosed.
hold_or_disproof_rule: Hold if the filing remains aggregate SPPCRC revenue only; weaken if category is excluded, disallowed, refunded, or cannot be separated.
safe_claim: FPL remains the best regulated recovery bridge, but not cash-realization proof until category receipts/source allocation are captured.

cash_realization_gap: Asset-class cash yield and growth-versus-replacement economics are missing.
target_document_family: Fleet utilization, segment OEC, rental margin, capex split, and borrowing-base certificate
source_route: URI 10-Q/10-K tables; investor presentations; ABL public documents; AR securitization reports; possible lender certificates
fields_to_extract: fleet class; OEC; utilization; rental revenue; gross profit; maintenance capex; growth capex; sale proceeds; eligible collateral; advance rate; reserves
upgrade_rule: Upgrade if same-period fleet capital can be tied to rental revenue, margin, cash conversion, utilization, and recovery proceeds by class.
hold_or_disproof_rule: Hold if evidence stays company-level; weaken if growth depends mostly on acquisition goodwill or replacement need without cash yield.
safe_claim: URI is the strongest cash-conversion proxy, not full asset-level ROIC proof.

cash_realization_gap: Backlog collectability, owner funding, retainage, L/C usage, surety usage, and project margin are missing.
target_document_family: Project-owner funding and backlog cash collection evidence
source_route: Sterling 10-Q/10-K; credit agreement schedules; surety/L/C disclosures; project awards; owner agency budget records
fields_to_extract: RPO; backlog burn; contract liabilities; retainage; billed receivables; L/C outstanding; surety bonded backlog; owner funding; margin; cancellation
upgrade_rule: Upgrade if backlog converts into revenue/cash with owner funding and risk supports visible in same period.
hold_or_disproof_rule: Hold if only RPO and company OCF are visible; weaken if backlog is unsigned, acquired-only, low-margin, cancellable, or working-capital intensive.
safe_claim: Sterling is conversion-supported, but project cash and risk allocation remain open.

cash_realization_gap: Train-level project cash, debt service, waterfall, and customer economics are missing.
target_document_family: Project-finance waterfall, SPA economics, train-level debt/capex/revenue schedule
source_route: Cheniere SEC filings; SPL/CQP indentures; offering memoranda; FERC project dockets; DOE export data; SPA/IPP customer filings
fields_to_extract: train; entity; source/use; debt draw; restricted cash; SPA volume; price formula; cargo/customer; revenue; EBITDA; debt service; distribution
upgrade_rule: Upgrade if train/entity source-use-output can be tied to customer revenue/cash and debt service.
hold_or_disproof_rule: Hold if only entity debt and cargo counts are visible; weaken if output cannot be mapped to contracted cash or project debt.
safe_claim: Cheniere is strong physical-output evidence, not yet project-cash-grade.

cash_realization_gap: Facility size, funds flow, borrower cash use, repayment source, and bank role are missing for most borrowers.
target_document_family: Borrower credit agreements, rating reports, funds-flow records, payoff evidence, lender schedules
source_route: SEC borrower/proxy filings; sponsor financing releases; rating agency reports; UCC/payoff searches; BDC schedule footnotes
fields_to_extract: borrower; facility; lender; amount; tranche; use of proceeds; repayment target; old bank role; borrower EBITDA/cash; covenant; maturity
upgrade_rule: Upgrade if holder exposure can be mapped to facility, use, cash generation or repayment capacity, and bank-role outcome.
hold_or_disproof_rule: Hold if only fair value/commitment rows exist; weaken if use is dividend, refinancing-only, or lender role differs from hypothesis.
safe_claim: Private credit is destination-proven, not generally cash-use-proven.

cash_realization_gap: The broad before/after bank-role pattern is not proven.
target_document_family: Credit-agreement termination and retained ancillary bank-role evidence
source_route: SEC 8-K/proxy exhibits; UCC releases; lender schedules; administrative-agent records; treasury/hedging disclosures; rating reports
fields_to_extract: old facility; old agent; payoff; termination; new facility; new lender group; revolver; treasury; hedging; collateral; agency role
upgrade_rule: Upgrade if multiple cases show whether banks exited, stayed, or migrated roles after private-credit financing.
hold_or_disproof_rule: Hold if only one-off takeout evidence exists; weaken broad replacement if banks retain material revolver/treasury/hedging roles.
safe_claim: Bank replacement is selected-case visible, not broad-pattern proven.

cash_realization_gap: Ultimate liability/source allocation to borrower assets is missing.
target_document_family: Vehicle liability stack and asset-pool allocation documents
source_route: BDC annual reports; non-traded BDC prospectuses; notes payable schedules; subscription facility documents; CLO/SPV filings; statutory schedules
fields_to_extract: assets; debt; notes; credit facilities; equity/NAV; leverage; asset coverage; subscription funding; CLO/SPV; insurance liability; borrower asset pool
upgrade_rule: Upgrade if same-period vehicle liabilities can be tied to the asset pool that includes the borrower without one-dollar overclaiming.
hold_or_disproof_rule: Hold if stack is visible but not allocable; weaken if vehicle is only historical or borrower exposure no longer current.
safe_claim: Vehicle-stack proof is source context, not exact borrower-dollar provenance.

safe_claim: Publication language is usable only with cash-realization boundaries.

cash_realization_gap: Statutory investment income, liability funding, and realized cash/spread allocation are missing.
